title: SeaBatical
meta_description: Private Pool with Gulf Lake & Park Views- SeaBatical by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: SeaBatical by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 55 Gulf Shore Drive Details: SeaBatical is a beautifully renovated home located in the highly sought-after Gulf Trace community of Grayton Beach. Offering 4,522 square feet of indoor and outdoor living space, this coastal retreat accommodates up to 10 guests with four bedrooms and four full baths. Surrounded by the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park, the home showcases stunning panoramic views of the State Park dunes, Alligator Lake, the beach, and the Gulf of Mexico from multiple outdoor decks and porches. Designed for relaxed coastal living, SeaBatical features a spacious living area with vaulted ceilings, a fully equipped kitchen, and plenty of indoor and outdoor gathering space. Outside, guests can enjoy a private heated pool, screened porch, four decks, and easy access to two private neighborhood beach accesses. The home's Gulf Trace setting provides a peaceful retreat surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park while remaining just a short distance from the restaurants, galleries, and laid-back atmosphere of historic Grayton Beach. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Short Walk to (2) Private Neighborhood Beach Accesses -Parking Spaces: (4) -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Private Heated Pool* -Expansive Gulf, Beach, Alligator Lake, and Grayton Beach State Park Views -Private Gulf-Front Neighborhood -Screened Porch -(4) Outdoor Decks -Outdoor Gas Grill -Outdoor Shower *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per day. *Pool heating must be arranged prior to arrival. *The electric pool heater will not operate when ambient temperatures fall below approximately 55 degrees and is not recommended during colder weather. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bedrooms / 4 Baths Ground Level: -Bedroom 1 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Double Bunks with Full Bath (Tub/Shower) *Please Note: The bunk room is accessed by an exterior door only and does not have interior access to the upper levels. First Level: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Outdoor Deck and Detached Full Bath (Tub/Shower) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Laundry Room -Screened Porch -Outdoor Deck with Panoramic Views Second Level: -Bedroom 3: (2) Twin Beds with Full Bath (Tub/Shower) and Private Outdoor Deck -Bedroom 4 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Double Vanity), Private Outdoor Deck and Panoramic Views of Alligator Lake, Grayton Beach State Park, Beach and Gulf Please Note: *LSVsand on-street parking are prohibited within the Gulf Trace neighborhood. *The ground-level bunk room has exterior access only with no interior access to the upper floors. *The living room fireplace is decorative only and is not available for guest use. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
